description.en: Read a repository's RFDs (docs/rfd) and reading notes (docs/reading), a tab each: filter by state and tag, search the full text, see review comments beside their lines, preview linked docs, jump with Cmd-/, and propose a new RFD or note as a pull request without a clone.

scopes.integration:github:read: Read the RFD and reading note files, their pull requests and review comments through your own GitHub sign-in.
scopes.storage:local: Keep the RFDs and reading notes you read, so the lists open at once and work offline.
scopes.workspace:write: Open a pull request, a note's source or a link in a browser tab when you click it.
